column1: # dictionary-hand-edits.tsv -- words added to the FreeLing es-CL 2027 dictionary by hand.
# What goes here: a reading the dictionary should have, exactly as FreeLing writes it. One reading per line, three fields separated by one tab:
#   form    the word as written, in lower case (FreeLing looks words up in lower case)
#   tag     its full tag in the Chilean tagset (e.g. NCMS000, NCMN000 for a noun with the same plural, AQ0CS00, RG, I)
# A word with several readings (singular and plural, masculine and feminine) gets one line for each.
# The build adds every line at every build and refuses a tag the Chilean tagset cannot decode. Lines starting with # are comments; empty lines are ignored.
# To take a reading out again, delete its line.
